name: CBS Bahamas (Commonwealth Building Supplies)
brand_truth: A building contractor's little Robinson Road store from 1973 that grew into the 30,000 sq ft Home Center on Carmichael Road, built around storm-ready windows and doors.

design.signature: Louvred hurricane shutter that closes slat by slat as you scroll into the storm-ready windows and doors section

current_site_findings: The contact page says 'email us at' but the email address is missing.
Directories list two different main numbers (242-677-2100 and 242-325-2505).
Opening hours differ between listings; nothing clearly states when the Home Center is open.
No quick phone path to ask whether an item is in stock.
The 1973 Robinson Road story and the contractor PROstore are hard to find online.
pitch_line: Fifty-three years of building Nassau deserves a site where a customer can see your departments and tap to call in five seconds.
notes: CONFLICT TO VERIFY: prospects.json site check says cbsbahamas.com serves affiliate spam, but WebFetch of cbsbahamas.com/contact-us--6 on 2026-11-04 returned a real-looking CBS contact page (phone 242-677-2100, 'email us at' with no address). Check the domain in a browser before pitching; the domain-lost angle was kept out of the concept panel for that reason. Canonical uses www.cbsbahamas.com. Hours omitted (bahamaslocal says Mon-Sat 8-8, Sun 9-5; 2014 Tribune gives different showroom hours). No email/WhatsApp found, so no form, call block instead. Leadership names (John Treco president 2014; Duran Wallace VP Ops; Brent Burrows II VP Retail & Sales) are sourced but left off the site in case they are dated. PROstore address unknown. No photos used. QA warnings: concept ribbon button under 40px on mobile (shared component).
